data.one_liner: Lightweight UDP library for Dart supporting Unicast, Broadcast, Multicast and Loopback communications.
data.what_it_does: Provides a UDP implementation for sending and receiving datagrams over the network. Supports binding to endpoints, broadcasting, multicasting, and handling data streams.
use_when: You need to send or receive UDP datagrams in Dart
You need support for broadcast, multicast, or loopback communications
avoid_when: You need reliable, connection-oriented TCP communication
You are communicating over HTTP, WebSockets, or gRPC
strengths: Easy to use API with stream support
Supports unicast, broadcast, multicast, and loopback
weaknesses: Limited to UDP protocol capabilities (no built-in reliability or ordering)
